bio: This restaurant brings a breath of fresh air to Toledo’s dining scene! Following a trip to Japan, the chef returned home with the idea of setting up a restaurant in which the bar counter would take centre stage, and where he would cook, prepare and present dishes in front of guests as in a typical sushi bar. This extremely comfortable restaurant, designed to seat 16 guests, boasts a surprising design, with a decor of golden tones and a ceiling covered with striking geometric shapes. The single, particularly interesting tasting menu features contemporary, market-inspired dishes such as tuna with white garlic, creamy rice with wild boar, and a “coolant” of marzipan with cheese and passion fruit....
